query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notifications (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  type ENUM('ALERT', 'REPORT', 'SYSTEM', 'INFO', 'WARNING', 'SUCCESS') DEFAULT 'INFO' NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  entityType VARCHAR(50),
  entityId INT,
  actionUrl VARCHAR(500),
  isRead BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
  readAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  priority ENUM('LOW', 'NORMAL', 'HIGH', 'URGENT') DEFAULT 'NORMAL' NOT NULL,
  expiresAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  metadata JSON,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_notifications_user (userId),
  INDEX idx_notifications_type (type),
  INDEX idx_notifications_read (isRead),
  INDEX idx_notifications_priority (priority),
  INDEX idx_notifications_created (createdAt),
  INDEX idx_notifications_user_unread (userId, isRead)
);
